featureType.title: timePladias
featureType.nativeCRS: GEOGCS["WGS 84", DATUM["World Geodetic System 1984", SPHEROID["WGS 84", 6378137.0, 298.257223563, AUTHORITY["EPSG","7030"]], AUTHORITY["EPSG","6326"]], PRIMEM["Greenwich", 0.0, AUTHORITY["EPSG","8901"]], UNIT["degree", 0.017453292519943295], AXIS["Geodetic longitude", EAST], AXIS["Geodetic latitude", NORTH], AUTHORITY["EPSG","4326"]]

virtualTable.name: timePladias
virtualTable.sql:
WITH sub as (
select MAX(m.latest_occurrence) AS latest_occurrence, q.geom_wgs FROM pladiascz.m_latest_occurrence m JOIN geodata.quadrants_full q ON (q.id=m.quadrant) WHERE m.taxon_id IN ( SELECT id FROM public.taxons WHERE lft >= (SELECT lft FROM public.taxons WHERE id=%TAXON_ID%) AND rgt <= (SELECT rgt FROM public.taxons WHERE id=%TAXON_ID%) ) GROUP BY q.geom_wgs )
SELECT geom_wgs, CASE WHEN latest_occurrence < %YEAR% THEN 'old' WHEN latest_occurrence >= %YEAR% THEN 'new' WHEN latest_occurrence is null THEN 'empty' END status from sub
